title: I Gave a Chess YouTuber 1 Dragon Until I LOSE
summary: Reverse dragon odds vs chess YouTuber Croissant (Croissantdealer11): Croissant has only a king plus N Dragons (bishop + knight), Tony (White) has the full army; one dragon is added after every Tony win. He trades queen for the lone dragon in game 1 and ladder-mates, keeps winning as dragons are added, and finally loses to a brilliant dragon mating net with five dragons (~20:48). Croissant predicted five would be enough.
rules: Opponent: king + N Dragons (N starts at 1, +1 after each player win). Player: full standard army as White.
Run ends when the player loses (lost at 5).
5-minute online games (custom FEN via 'Create a game').
win_condition: Checkmate the dragon side each game; run ends on the first loss.

board.theme_notes: lichess-style grey/stone board with cburnett pieces, webcams of both players, 5-min clocks

setup: White: standard army. Black: Ke8 + N dragons (custom FEN; positions visual-only).
events: +1 opponent dragon after each player win
current_impl_issues: Impl 'gift' gives the bot extra archbishops ON TOP of a full army; video's opponent has ONLY king + dragons.
evidence: Own srt: 00:02 'give him one extra dragon each game until I lose' / 'five dragons will be enough'; 00:23-00:47 trade queen for the dragon; 01:12 move on to two dragons; 20:33-20:48 'we do lose against five dragons'. Frame visual_a webcams, Croissantdealer11.
